async def _judge_phase(
    deps: PostProcessDeps,
    actions: list[JsonObject],
) -> JudgeLoopResult:
    """Run the per-field judge and emit its honest phase summary."""
    await emit_phase_message(
        deps,
        phase=src.key_catalog.GRAPH_PHASE_JUDGE,
        message="Reviewing planned answers.",
    )
    judge_result = await run_per_field_judge_loop(
        JudgeLoopDeps(
            adapter=deps.adapter,
            emit_event=deps.emit_event,
            llm_client=deps.llm_client,
        ),
        actions,
        deps.payload,
    )
    logger.info(
        "postprocess: judge complete",
        verdict=judge_result.overall_verdict,
        skipped=judge_result.skipped_reason is not None,
    )
    judge_summary = (
        f"Judge: skipped — {judge_result.skipped_reason}"
        if judge_result.skipped_reason is not None
        else f"Judge: {judge_result.overall_verdict}"
    )
    await deps.emit_event(
        deps.adapter.adapt_run_summary(
            RunSummaryParams(phase="judge_complete", content=judge_summary)
        )
    )
    return judge_result
